# OpenCode Computer Use

> A dual-generation OpenCode plugin that exposes a Codex-style persistent JavaScript session (cua_repl) for local desktop control. The model sees two tools, js and js_reset, backed by the open-source open-computer-use native runtime. OS permissions remain enforced.

## Key facts

- MCP server name: cua_repl. Model-facing tools: js (persistent evaluation) and js_reset (clean session).
- Async cua API: listApps, getApp, getState, getAXState, getScreenshot, getAXStateAndScreenshot, click, scroll, drag, typeText, pressKey, setValue, performSecondaryAction. Output helpers: nodeRepl.write, nodeRepl.emitImage.
- WebMCP preview: the docs page registers only read-only search_docs, get_install_config, and get_api_reference tools when document.modelContext is available. It is progressive enhancement, not stable browser support.
- No arbitrary shell escape. No run_shell in the model-facing API. Restricted VM blocks require, process, fetch, filesystem, dynamic import, and code generation.
- Published package: @frontendxlab/opencode-computer-use.
- Requirements: Node.js 18 or newer, OpenCode 1.18.29 or newer (V1) or OpenCode2 V2, plus a signed-in graphical desktop session with OS accessibility and capture permissions.
- Native runtimes packaged for darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, linux-arm64, linux-x64, win32-arm64, win32-x64. Live smoke tests passed on Linux x64 only; macOS and Windows need on-host validation.
